metadata.case_name: KO HOI SEUNG KORIN v. LIU KWOK KEUNG

plaintiff.occupation_before: Accountant for a company called Hi-Bisshi (HK) Ltd; director and 30% shareholder
plaintiff.occupation_after: Accountant for a company called Hi-Bisshi (HK) Ltd; director and 30% shareholder

injuries.description: whiplash injury causing a sprained neck with soft tissue (paraspinal and trapezius muscles) involvement
source: the plaintiff probably had suffered from a whiplash injury causing a sprained neck with soft tissue (paraspinal and trapezius muscles) involvement, which was compatible with the described mode of accident.
injuries.icd_description: Acute whiplash associated disorder with complaint of neck pain with musculoskeletal signs

injuries.description: injury to right shoulder and right upper limb numbness
injuries.body_part: right shoulder and right upper limb
source: it is not disputed that her right shoulder was injured and she suffered from right upper limb numbness as a result of the accident based on the various medical records and documents.
injuries.icd_description: Injury of unspecified nerve at shoulder or upper arm level

manifestations.description: intermittent neck pain, which was worse upon end of extension and prolonged desk work
limited neck range of motion limited by pain
paraspinal and trapezius muscle tenderness and spasm
intermittent left hand numbness over tip of radical 3 fingers (recorded at joint examination but the court found this exaggerated)

treatments_received: Attendances at Accident & Emergency Department of Alice Ho Miu Ling Nethersole Hospital
Orthopaedic consultations (Baptist Hospital; Dr Wilkie Ngai; Dr Kenric Lau)
Physiotherapy (11 sessions ending on 27 September 2012; additional 25 sessions from 18 October 2012 to 28 May 2013)
